audit.whatIsWrong: Ability slots are swapped throughout the content layer: Abyssal Dive is repeatedly tagged '(R)' and Devour is repeatedly tagged '(W)'. Per enemyKit, W = Abyssal Dive (the dive-in/dive-out engage) and R = Devour (the eat/save ability).
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/tahmkench.json enemyAbilities: W=Abyssal Dive, R=Devour. spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[1] all carry the reversed slot letters.
audit.corrected: Swap the slot letters back: Abyssal Dive -> (W), Devour -> (R) in every occurrence.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags Thick Skin (E) / Devour (R) absorbing burst damage as a matchup-relevant interaction with no page coverage.
audit.why: Tahm's E passively banks a shield from damage taken; committing an all-in into a banked shield wastes the burst window.
audit.corrected: Fold into breakdown.trading as a bad-trade note.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep RE shield-speed banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
